code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != 0]

    def spans(n, separators):
        out, start = [], 0
        for s in separators:
            if start < s:
                out.append((start, s))
            start = s + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out

    row_bands, col_bands = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        occupied = [any(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
                    for c0, c1 in col_bands]
        paired = [occupied[j] and ((j > 0 and occupied[j - 1]) or
                                   (j + 1 < len(col_bands) and occupied[j + 1]))
                  for j in range(len(col_bands))]
        for j, present in enumerate(occupied):
            if not present or paired[j]:
                continue
            inward = 1 if j == 0 else len(col_bands) - 2 if j == len(col_bands) - 1 else (j + 1 if j < len(col_bands) / 2 else j - 1)
            choices = [inward] + [k for k in (j + 1, j - 1) if k != inward]
            for k in choices:
                if not (0 <= k < len(col_bands)):
                    continue
                a0, a1 = col_bands[j]
                b0, b1 = col_bands[k]
                if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0:
                    continue
                for rr in range(r0, r1):
                    for off in range(a1 - a0):
                        value = g[rr][a1 - 1 - off]
                        if value:
                            g[rr][b0 + off] = value
                break
    return g
'''
